decisions.reason: The temporary PDF delivery and new-tab behavior for policy documents do not change the Cognito Sign-In branding requirements.
The informational-page shell is defined for pages such as Sign In and Account Provisioning; temporarily serving Cookie and Privacy documents as PDFs does not necessarily alter its shell elements.
Policy-document format and link behavior do not change the provisioning wizard's styling state; its same-message background update is independent and already represented.
The optional prototype-code deliverable targets Sign In and Account Provisioning pages, not the temporary delivery of policy documents.

The footer still contains the same policy menu links; their destination format and new-tab behavior are independently owned by the policy-access Requirement and do not make any footer attribute stale.
The policy-document delivery change does not affect required webfont files, families, formats, or metadata.
Opening policy PDFs in separate tabs does not change the landing page's section order, copy plan, or How It Works sequence.
The policy-document format and access behavior do not change the design-token specification.
Temporarily delivering policy content as PDFs does not modify the established dark theme for website pages.
Policy-document access does not affect the admin workspace shell's components, styling dimensions, theme modes, or deliverable boundary.
The panel-navigation discussion is a separate clause in the source message; the policy-document decision does not alter panel placement or resolve its ambiguity.
The policy-document delivery change has no effect on hero text emphasis or hero presentation.
